newcomerCriteria: Free English language tuition reaches a child who is the dependant of an EEA national worker
That child must also be of compulsory school age and resident in Gibraltar
The duty is framed as facilitating the initial reception of the child
The Director must ensure the free tuition is made available where those conditions are met
An asylum applicant or a child with refugee or subsidiary protection status counts as resident

evidence.bullet: Free English language tuition reaches a child who is the dependant of an EEA national worker
evidence.quote: the child is the dependant of an EEA national who is a worker, within the meaning given in Article 45 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union

evidence.bullet: That child must also be of compulsory school age and resident in Gibraltar
evidence.quote: the child is of compulsory school age; (b) the child is resident in Gibraltar; and

evidence.bullet: The duty is framed as facilitating the initial reception of the child
evidence.quote: For the purpose of facilitating the initial reception of a child

evidence.bullet: The Director must ensure the free tuition is made available where those conditions are met
evidence.quote: the Director shall ensure that free tuition, including in particular English language tuition, is made available to that child where the following conditions are met

evidence.bullet: An asylum applicant or a child with refugee or subsidiary protection status counts as resident
evidence.quote: is an applicant or dependant family member of an applicant under the Asylum Regulations 2008; or (vi) has refugee status or subsidiary protection status under the Asylum Regulations 2008

sources.label: Education and Training Act 1974-11, ss. 53A and 73, Laws of Gibraltar consolidation
